AI for DevOps & SRE: From Impressive Demos to Operational Trust What would make you trust an AI agent with operational changes? How do we recognize these failures before they affect real systems? Join Bucharest XDevOps Meetup for a practical, vendor-neutral session exploring the risks of AI-assisted operations and the controls that help manage them.
